'''Flann Barstere''' is a young [[Two Rivers]] man from [[Watch Hill]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Flann Barstere}}

== Appearance ==
He is lanky with a dent in his chin.

== Activities ==
He is part of the [[Two Rivers]] men in [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army in [[Ghealdan]].

He leaves with Perrin for [[So Habor]] to buy some grain for the army.
